regime_context: The detector shows a single dominant theme (AI Infrastructure) at the top with a modest lead and no crowding flag, while the absolute-trend gate is validated for drawdown control on this market (gate_helps=true). Rotation breadth is narrowing (39% eligible) and the rotation signal itself is directional=false, so I read this as a continuation-friendly but not confirmatory tape. Track record hit rate is decent but directional accuracy is near coin-flip (~48%), so I default conviction low across the board.
emerging_watch: Watching whether AI Semiconductors (rank 14, eligible, breadth 0.833, Hurst 'trend') climbs into the top 5 ranks — that would confirm a broadening of AI leadership beyond the AI Infrastructure label. If AI Semiconductors fails to move above rank 10 or loses its eligible=true gate within 20 trading days, the watch retires.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: The trend-gate is the only validated edge and AI Infrastructure passes it (eligible=true) with the top rank and broad participation (breadth 0.708). Its Hurst tag is 'mixed' rather than pure trend, so this is a carry-the-leader lean, not a momentum call, and the size-down caution does not apply since crowding_z=0.59 and crowded=false.
evidence: rank=1, score=1.975, eligible=true (absolute-trend gate, the validated risk-control leg)
breadth=0.708 — participation is reasonably broad for the leader
crowded=false, crowding_z=0.59 — no reflexivity caution to cap it
durability_bar=0.68 — above-average staying power within this snapshot
theses.dissent: Hurst 'mixed' plus val_state 'fading' warn that the trend is already losing internal momentum; the leader may chop sideways rather than accrue, and the detector explicitly has no forward return edge.

falsifier.text: SMH closes more than 8% below its own 50-day average before the check-by date, or AI Infrastructure's breadth drops below 0.45 while still ranked first.

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy is the highest-ranked eligible theme with a clean 'trend' Hurst tag (not 'mixed' like the top three), passing the absolute-trend gate that has validated drawdown control here. It is not crowded (z=0.83) and has healthy breadth (0.727), so the trend discipline leg supports staying with it.
evidence: eligible=true, hurst_tag='trend' — the trend health leg is stronger here than for the leader
breadth=0.727 with rank 4 — broad participation among eligible themes
crowded=false, crowding_z=0.83 — no sizing caution triggered
durability_bar=0.68 — above the typical threshold in this snapshot
theses.dissent: Energy's score is barely above 1.0 and it sits behind three semiconductor/AI themes, so any rotation back into tech leadership would sap its relative standing; the detector's rank-IC is ~0 so the rank itself tells us nothing about future returns.

falsifier.text: XLE loses relative strength to SMH by 10% over any 10-day window before the check-by date, or XLE's breadth falls below 0.5 while still eligible.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity passes the trend gate and has perfect breadth (1.0) with a clean 'trend' Hurst tag, but crowding is flagged (crowded=true, crowding_z=1.8). Per guardrails this is a size-down caution only, never a fade — so I express it as 'avoid' rather than a tactical underweight or short.
evidence: crowded=true, crowding_z=1.8 — the only crowding flag among top themes
rank=2, eligible=true, breadth=1.0 — leadership is real but extended
durability_bar=0.85 — high, but the crowding texture dominates the read
theses.dissent: The documented failure mode is fading a leader on a crowding flag; Cybersecurity could simply continue to lead and an 'avoid' costs relative performance if the AI-adjacent security narrative persists.

falsifier.text: CIBR makes a new 60-day high and crowding_z drops back below 1.0 while still ranked in the top 5 before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
